Name: North Cove Park
Description: North Cove Park is a waterfront park in downtown Lake Stevens. I would include this because it shows the lake and gives visitors a good first feel for the area.

Name: The Mill on Lake Stevens
Description: The Mill is a community gathering spot near the lake. I would include it because it feels connected to local events and the small-town side of Lake Stevens.

Name: Lundeen Park
Description: Lundeen Park is a place I would show someone who wanted to see the lake in a more relaxed way. It represents the outdoor and family-friendly feeling of Lake Stevens.

Name: Lake Stevens Library
Description: The Lake Stevens Library is a useful community place and adds an educational stop to the map. I like including libraries because they show more than just tourist spots.

Name: Centennial Trail 20th Street Trailhead
Description: The Centennial Trail gives the map an outdoor recreation location. It is the kind of place I would include for someone who wanted to walk, bike, or see more of the area.

Name: Centennial Trail WA 92 Trailhead
Description: This trailhead gives another public access point to the Centennial Trail. I included it because trails are part of how people experience the Lake Stevens area.

Name: Space Needle
Description: The Space Needle is one of the most recognizable places in Seattle. I would include it for a visitor because it immediately gives the map a clear Seattle landmark.

Name: Pike Place Market
Description: Pike Place Market is one of the places I think visitors expect to see in Seattle. It adds food, history, and local character to the map.

Name: Woodland Park Zoo
Description: Woodland Park Zoo adds a family-friendly and outdoor location to the map. I included it because it gives visitors something fun to do beyond the downtown area.

Name: T-Mobile Park
Description: T-Mobile Park adds a sports location to the map. I included it because sports are something I enjoy, and a Mariners game would be a fun Seattle stop for a visitor.
